chapters.label: Live: the 2025 final
chapters.text: Copa Libertadores final, 2025. Peñarol lead Magnus, one to nothing. Magnus goalkeeper Andre Pereira strikes a left-foot rocket. Mathi Fernández stops it!

chapters.label: The winning throw
chapters.text: Late on, Peñarol lead two to one. Mathi throws to Franco Duque, who lifts it over the last defender into the empty goal. Three to one. Champions!

chapters.label: How he reacts (demo)
chapters.text: This is how he reacts. Hands up in front, knees soft. The ball flies in, and his hands are already there. Saved!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Your turn. Keep your hands ready in front of you, so you can react in a flash!
